summary: Iteration 57 - Tested children bulk import (parent_cache, admin campus fallback), group types CRUD, venues CRUD with is_external flag, location venues endpoint, LocationsPage UI (Venues/Group Types sections, expanded timezones), badge dark background defaults, and country outlines module. All features working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed venues and group types for testing (cleaned up)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 57 features verified: (1) POST /api/children/bulk-import uses parent_cache to skip repeated parents in same batch, and falls back to admin's active_campus_id when no location specified. (2) GET /api/group-types returns group types and creates defaults (General, Staff, Volunteers, Youth, Women, Men, Children, Leadership) if empty. POST/DELETE work for admin. (3) GET/POST/DELETE /api/venues work correctly. VenueCreate model updated to include is_external field. (4) GET /api/locations/{id}/venues includes external venues (is_external=true or no location_id). (5) LocationsPage has Venues section with add/delete, Group Types section with add/delete, and expanded timezone options (50+ including Asia/Bangkok, America/Port-au-Prince). (6) Badge components (StaffBadge, ParentBadge, ChildTag) default to kioskMode=false with dark backgrounds. (7) Country outlines module loads correctly using rawCountriesData?.default fallback for ESM/CJS compatibility.
